notes: Two-tone instrument palette + one rationed accent. The raw profile shows a single font/size/weight (B612 Mono 12px/400) and a single radius (64px pill) — confirmed by screenshots; there is genuinely no type scale, so 'scale' lists one step and 'muted' collapses to fg (no mid-grays exist). bg normalized to off-white #f4f5f6 (raw rgb(244,245,246)); accent #ff5c00 appears in only 2 elements in the raw counts, matching its ~1% use in the screenshot. Shadow = none: chrome is flat, separation is by whitespace not elevation. Spacing scale is bimodal — tight 4/8/16 for chrome, then a large jump to 64/128 for section padding/gap; intermediate steps are absent. The 3D sphere geometry, particle field, and per-thumbnail transforms are WebGL-rendered and not represented in computed-style tokens. MOTION: this is a Three.js + GSAP WebGL stage, not a static page — ~1439 rAF/pass (continuous render loop), 2 canvas, 4 mousemove with 0 cursor-followers (pointer drives sphere drag/inertia via Draggable, not a custom cursor), 1 @keyframes ('spin'), and all 5 scroll effects are position:fixed pins (nav + corner HUD + footer cluster + canvas). prefers-reduced-motion is NOT respected (prmRules:0) — the headline a11y defect, plus 12 sub-44px tap targets and a non-crawlable/AT-invisible canvas; offsetting wins are img_alt_ratio:1 and focus_visible:true. The scroll frames did NOT capture the motion (pinned stage + in-canvas/pointer rotation → DOM-diff frames are pixel-identical), so motion is grounded in probe counts + library fingerprint + 'spin' keyframe + DOM markup, not stills. techniques[] lists only existing corpus patterns (webgl-thumbnail-sphere, monospace-hud-chrome, viewport-frame-ticks); genuinely-new behaviors (drag-to-orbit inertia, glitch-scramble text) are recorded under patterns_to_build, not faked into techniques. type tracking_by_size is empty in raw (single 12px size; mono advance does the spacing); grid-template-columns '3' is incidental, not a real design grid.
